writeup: TIC 59603820 is a newly discovered eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 15.38 days. The primary star dims by 17.35 percent as its companion passes in front of it, while a secondary eclipse was also detected at high confidence. This system had gone unnoticed in six major variable-star catalogs until now, making it a genuine addition to our knowledge of binary stars. The detection was confirmed through multiple independent methods, including pixel-level imaging that pinpointed the star's precise location in the sky. The alternating eclipse depths revealed the true orbital period, demonstrating how careful analysis of eclipse patterns can unlock the real properties of distant stellar systems.
